scope: opt-in Recovery Set Cron service and isolated WordPress hook, not installed plugin or long-running scheduler acceptance
limitations: UTC daily slots only; no backfill
one Collector operation per invocation, not a hard process execution timeout
failure and configuration change require review; no reset API
concurrency and interrupted lease cases are fault-injection contracts, not multi-host load tests
no multi-day WP-Cron daemon test or production deployment
trusted adapters and result reporter must be explicitly configured
